description: Supplement to "Probabilistic load forecasting for the low voltage network: forecast fusion and daily peaks is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Ciaran Gilbert, Jethro Browell (University of Strathclyde). This deposit contains the scripts and data used in the research article "Probabilistic load forecasting for the low voltage network: forecast fusion and daily peaks", which proposed a novel method for electricity demand forecasting in low voltage networks. The scripts are written in the form of R markdown and include additional commentary on the methodology. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
